= Error catalogue: rendered messages (generated, regression-tested)
:toc: macro

This page is the wording contract for both message styles; link:ERROR-CATALOGUE.adoc[the error catalogue] explains them.
Every block is the exact output of the *prototype* launcher (`scripts/proto/idris2x.sh`) for fixed sample values, at 80 columns.
`scripts/proto/dx-golden.sh --check` fails when any character here would change. The Rust launcher's message module
(`src/msg.rs`) must give the same bytes; CI checks it with `IDRIS2X_BIN=target/debug/idris2x scripts/proto/dx-golden.sh --check`.

In the terminal form, `<ESC>` stands for the escape byte (0x1b) that starts a colour sequence: `<ESC>[1;31m` is bold red,
`<ESC>[36m` cyan, `<ESC>[1m` bold and `<ESC>[0m` reset. `--json` output is one line; it is the same for both styles.

== E-USAGE

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)

----
idris2x: E-USAGE (exit 2)

I do not know the command instal.

    you-typed  instal
    commands   pin, install, exec, run, env, verify, gc, fetch, doctor, selftest, explain, help

Nothing was run.

The first word after idris2x must be one of the commands listed above.

See what each command does:

    idris2x help

More: idris2x explain E-USAGE

=== E-USAGE, case `bad-setting`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-USAGE (exit 2)

IDRIS2X_LOCK_TIMEOUT must be a whole number of seconds, and it is set to
something else.

    setting  IDRIS2X_LOCK_TIMEOUT
    value    ten

Nothing was run.

idris2x refuses a setting it cannot read. It does not fall back to a default, so
a typo never changes what runs.

Set IDRIS2X_LOCK_TIMEOUT to a whole number of seconds, or unset it to use the
default.

More: idris2x explain E-USAGE
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-USAGE.adoc
----

== E-PIN-NOT-FOUND

=== E-PIN-NOT-FOUND, case `no-lock`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PIN-NOT-FOUND (exit 10)

There is no idris2x.lock in this directory, so I do not know which Idris 2 to
run.

    directory   /home/ada/proofs
    looked-for  idris2x.lock

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

idris2x never guesses a version. Every run is tied to a lock file, so the same
command gives the same compiler on every machine.

If this is the project root, pin a version here:

    idris2x pin <version>

If the project already has a lock file, change to the directory that holds it:
the lock is read from the current directory only.

More: idris2x explain E-PIN-NOT-FOUND
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-PIN-NOT-FOUND.adoc
----

If this is the project root, pin a version here:

    <ESC>[1midris2x pin <version><ESC>[0m

If the project already has a lock file, change to the directory that holds it:

  why: idris2x never guesses a version. Every run is tied to a lock file, so the same command gives the same compiler on every machine.
  fix: idris2x pin <version>
  note: If the project already has a lock file, change to the directory that holds it: the lock is read from the current directory only.
  see: idris2x explain E-PIN-NOT-FOUND
  see: https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-PIN-NOT-FOUND.adoc
----

=== E-PIN-NOT-FOUND, case `no-target`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PIN-NOT-FOUND (exit 10)

idris2x.lock does not pin a capsule for this machine.

    this-machine  aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    lock-covers   x86_64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

The lock records one capsule per platform. It was written when the channel had
none for this platform.

Pin again to pick up every platform the channel offers now:

    idris2x pin 0.8.0

If aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu is still missing afterwards, no capsule is
published for it yet: see the supported platforms page.

    capsule  chez-10.4.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu

Some capsules carry only Chez Scheme. They serve idris2x run, not idris2x exec.

Scheme.

=== E-PIN-NOT-FOUND, case `malformed-lock`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PIN-NOT-FOUND (exit 10)

idris2x.lock records a digest for this machine that is not well formed.

    this-machine  x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
    field         digest

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

A digest is exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and a version is numbers
separated by dots. Anything else means the lock was edited by hand or damaged,
and it is refused before it can reach a download, a store path or a printed
command.

Write the lock again from the channel:

    idris2x pin <version>

If the lock is under version control, compare it with the last committed version
first.

More: idris2x explain E-PIN-NOT-FOUND
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-PIN-NOT-FOUND.adoc
----

=== E-PIN-NOT-FOUND, case `unreadable-lock`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PIN-NOT-FOUND (exit 10)

idris2x.lock is here, and I could not read it as a lock file.

    problem  expected value at line 1 column 1

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

A lock is JSON that idris2x pin writes. A file that cannot be opened, or that is
not that JSON, is refused, not guessed at.

Write the lock again from the channel:

    idris2x pin <version>

If the lock is under version control, compare it with the last committed version
first.

More: idris2x explain E-PIN-NOT-FOUND

== E-HASH-MISMATCH

=== E-HASH-MISMATCH, case `download`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-HASH-MISMATCH (exit 11)

The capsule I downloaded is not the one idris2x.lock pins.

    expected  sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21
    got       sha256:3f1c88a2d4e6071b95c3fa2e6d8097b4c1a5e3f7029b6d4c8a1e5f3b7d902c64
    size      17706495 bytes (the lock says 35412990)
    from      https://mirror.example.org/idris2-0.8.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-chez10.4.1.tar.gz

Nothing was installed. The bad download was deleted and the store is unchanged.

A mirror served a damaged, truncated or stale file. It can also mean tampering,
which is what this check exists to catch.

Try the download again:

    idris2x install --locked

If it fails again with the same got digest, the mirror is serving a bad file:
report it with the runbook below.

More: idris2x explain E-HASH-MISMATCH
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-HASH-MISMATCH.adoc
----

idris2x: E-HASH-MISMATCH (exit 11)

The bundle you gave me is not the capsule idris2x.lock pins.

    expected  sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21
    got       sha256:3f1c88a2d4e6071b95c3fa2e6d8097b4c1a5e3f7029b6d4c8a1e5f3b7d902c64
    size      35412990 bytes (the lock says 35412990)
    bundle    /media/usb/capsule.tar.gz

Nothing was installed. Your bundle file was left untouched.

The bundle was fetched for a different lock file, or it was damaged in transit.

    idris2x fetch -o capsule.tar.gz

Run that on a connected machine with this exact idris2x.lock, then copy the new
bundle here.

=== E-HASH-MISMATCH, case `store-modified`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-HASH-MISMATCH (exit 11)

An installed capsule no longer matches its own checksums.

    capsule      sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21
    store-entry  /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/store/sha256-0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

The capsule was left in place so that you can inspect it.

Files in the store changed after installation: by hand, by another tool, or
through disk corruption. The store is meant to be read-only.

Remove this capsule and install it again:

    rm -rf /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/store/sha256-0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21 && idris2x install --locked

Programs compiled with this capsule keep working once it is reinstalled, because
the store path stays the same.

More: idris2x explain E-HASH-MISMATCH
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-HASH-MISMATCH.adoc
----

== E-SIG-INVALID

=== E-SIG-INVALID, case `bad-signature`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-SIG-INVALID (exit 12)

The channel manifest's signature does not match its contents.

    manifest     https://channel.example.org/v1.json
    trusted-key  key id 9c41d07be2a5f316

The manifest was discarded. Your lock file and store are unchanged, and
everything already pinned still runs.

The manifest was altered after it was signed, or a mirror served a manifest and
a signature from two different publishes.

Wait a minute, then try once more in case a mirror was mid-update:

    idris2x pin 0.8.0

If it fails again, stop: there is no flag that skips this check. Follow the
runbook below to report the mirror.

=== E-SIG-INVALID, case `wrong-key`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-SIG-INVALID (exit 12)

The channel manifest was signed by a key I do not trust.

    manifest     https://channel.example.org/v1.json
    signed-by    key id 5be07a11c3d9f248
    trusted-key  key id 9c41d07be2a5f316

The manifest was discarded. Your lock file and store are unchanged, and
everything already pinned still runs.

This URL is not the channel this idris2x trusts, or the channel changed its key
after this idris2x was released, or someone is impersonating the channel.

Check that the manifest URL is the channel you meant. If it is, update idris2x,
because key changes ship in launcher releases. Never swap the trusted key by
hand.

More: idris2x explain E-SIG-INVALID

idris2x: E-PLATFORM-UNSUPPORTED (exit 13)

No capsules are built for this machine's processor type, riscv64.

    this-machine  riscv64
    supported     x86_64, aarch64

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

Each capsule holds programs compiled for one processor type and operating
system, and none has been built for this pair.

See the supported platforms page for the list and for how to ask for a new
target. Building Idris 2 from source remains possible without idris2x.

=== E-NETWORK, case `all-mirrors-failed`

idris2x: E-NETWORK (exit 14)

I could not download the pinned capsule from any mirror.

    capsule   sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21
    tried     https://mirror.example.org/idris2.tar.gz: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404; https://backup.example.net/idris2.tar.gz: (6) Could not resolve host: backup.example.net
    full-log  /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/staging/fetch.log

Nothing was installed. The store is unchanged.

Each address in the lock was tried in turn and each one failed for the reason
shown after it.

When the network is back, run it again:

    idris2x install --locked

If you are behind a proxy, check that HTTPS_PROXY is set. If every mirror
answers 404, the capsule was withdrawn: see the runbook below.

Running an already pinned toolchain does not need the network once its capsule

== E-LOCK-TIMEOUT

=== E-LOCK-TIMEOUT, case `held`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-LOCK-TIMEOUT (exit 15)

Another idris2x is installing the same capsule. I waited 600 seconds and then
gave up.

    capsule    sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21
    lock-file  /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/locks/sha256-0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21.lock
    held-by    process 48213 (still running)

This run installed nothing. The other install is not affected.

Installs of one capsule take turns, so two processes never write the same store
entry. A slow download in the other process is the usual cause.

Wait for the other install to finish, or allow more time:

    IDRIS2X_LOCK_TIMEOUT=1800 idris2x install --locked

Do not delete the lock file while its holder is running: two installs would then
write at once. The lock is released by itself when the holder exits.

More: idris2x explain E-LOCK-TIMEOUT
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-LOCK-TIMEOUT.adoc
----

== E-GLIBC-FLOOR

idris2x: E-GLIBC-FLOOR (exit 16)

This system's C library is too old for the pinned capsule.

    this-system    2.17
    capsule-needs  2.28
    capsule        sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

The capsule's programs were built against a newer glibc. On an older glibc they
would fail to start, with a less clear message than this one.

Run this project in a newer distribution or container image, one with at least
the glibc shown above. This check cannot be skipped.

=== E-GLIBC-FLOOR, case `unknown`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-GLIBC-FLOOR (exit 16)

The pinned capsule needs a minimum glibc, and I could not find out which glibc
this system has.

    capsule-needs  2.28
    capsule        sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

idris2x asks getconf GNU_LIBC_VERSION, with only PATH passed on from the
environment. Either getconf is not on PATH, or this system's C library is not
glibc: musl, as on Alpine, is not supported. A capsule on a C library it was not
built for fails to start, with a less clear message than this one.

Put getconf on PATH (on Debian and Ubuntu it is in the libc-bin package), or run
this project in a glibc-based distribution or container image. This check cannot
be skipped.

More: idris2x explain E-GLIBC-FLOOR
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-GLIBC-FLOOR.adoc
----

== E-PROBE-CODEGEN

=== E-PROBE-CODEGEN, case `chez-failed`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PROBE-CODEGEN (exit 17)

The capsule's Chez Scheme did not run correctly on this machine.

    check      pure_eval
    chez-said  error while loading shared libraries: libtinfo.so.6: cannot open shared object file

The capsule was not installed. The store is unchanged.

The capsule's files are intact, since the checksums passed, so something about
this machine stops the program running: a missing system library, a security
policy, or an unsupported processor.

Collect the facts for a report:

    idris2x doctor

The line after chez-said is Chez Scheme's own message, not ours. Send it with
the doctor output using the runbook below.

More: idris2x explain E-PROBE-CODEGEN
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-PROBE-CODEGEN.adoc

=== E-PROBE-CODEGEN, case `idris2-failed`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PROBE-CODEGEN (exit 17)

The capsule's Idris 2 did not start on this machine.

    check        version_match
    idris2-said  Exception: (while loading libidris2_support.so) cannot open shared object file

The capsule was not installed. The store is unchanged.

Chez Scheme runs, so the fault is in starting the compiler itself: usually its
support library could not be loaded.

Collect the facts for a report:

    idris2x doctor

The line after idris2-said is Idris 2's own message, not ours. Report this to
idris2x, not to the Idris 2 project: the fault is in how the capsule was built
or run.

idris2x: E-PROBE-CODEGEN (exit 17)

The capsule says it holds one version of Idris 2, and the compiler inside
reports another.

    capsule-says      0.8.0
    compiler-reports  Idris 2, version 0.7.0

The capsule was not installed. The store is unchanged.

The capsule was labelled wrongly when it was built. This is a fault in the
capsule, not in your machine.

Report the capsule using the runbook below. Until it is replaced, pin a
different version.

=== E-PROBE-CODEGEN, case `path-has-spaces`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PROBE-CODEGEN (exit 17)

Programs compiled by this toolchain cannot start, because the store path
contains a space.

    check        chez_codegen (run the compiled program)
    store-entry  /home/ada/My Cache/idris2x/store/sha256-0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

The capsule is installed and the compiler itself works. Only programs it
compiles with the Chez backend are affected.

A compiled program begins with a line naming Chez Scheme by its full path, and
the operating system splits that line at spaces.

Move the store to a path without spaces, then install again:

    export IDRIS2X_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/idris2x"

Any directory whose full path has no spaces will do. Programs built with --cg
refc are not affected.

More: idris2x explain E-PROBE-CODEGEN
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-PROBE-CODEGEN.adoc
----

== E-CHANNEL-SCHEMA

=== E-CHANNEL-SCHEMA, case `lock-newer`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-CHANNEL-SCHEMA (exit 18)

idris2x.lock was written by a newer idris2x than this one.

    file                idris2x.lock
    its-format          2
    this-idris2x-reads  1
    this-idris2x        0.1.0

Nothing was downloaded or changed. The lock file is intact.

Someone pinned this project with a newer idris2x. An older one refuses to guess
at fields it does not know.

Update idris2x to the version your colleagues use, then run the same command
again.

== E-PIN-DRIFT

=== E-PIN-DRIFT, case `toml-vs-lock`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-PIN-DRIFT (exit 19)

idris2x.toml and idris2x.lock name different versions of Idris 2.

    idris2x.toml  0.8.1
    idris2x.lock  0.8.0

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

One of the two files was edited without the other. With --locked the lock is
never rewritten to match.

Make the lock match idris2x.toml:

    idris2x pin 0.8.1

If the lock is the one that is right, change the version in idris2x.toml to the
one idris2x.lock pins instead.

More: idris2x explain E-PIN-DRIFT
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-PIN-DRIFT.adoc
----

== E-OFFLINE

=== E-OFFLINE, case `capsule-missing`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-OFFLINE (exit 20)

I need a capsule that is not in the store, and offline mode is on.

    capsule          sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21
    store            /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/store
    offline-because  IDRIS2X_OFFLINE=1

Nothing was downloaded, as you asked. The store is unchanged.

Offline mode never touches the network, so the capsule has to arrive another
way.

    idris2x fetch -o capsule.tar.gz

Run that on a connected machine with the same idris2x.lock, copy capsule.tar.gz
here, then run: idris2x install --from capsule.tar.gz

More: idris2x explain E-OFFLINE
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-OFFLINE.adoc
----

=== E-OFFLINE, case `no-manifest`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-OFFLINE (exit 20)

Pinning needs the channel manifest. None is cached, and offline mode is on.

    cache            /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/manifests/v1.json
    offline-because  IDRIS2X_OFFLINE=1

Nothing was changed.

pin reads the signed channel manifest. Offline, it can only use a copy cached by
an earlier online pin.

Run the pin once with the network allowed:

    IDRIS2X_OFFLINE=0 idris2x pin 0.8.0

Running an already pinned toolchain never needs the manifest: install --locked
and exec --locked work offline from the store.

More: idris2x explain E-OFFLINE
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-OFFLINE.adoc
----

== E-CAPSULE-INVALID

=== E-CAPSULE-INVALID, case `unsafe-path`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-CAPSULE-INVALID (exit 21)

The capsule archive contains a file that would be written outside the store, so
I refused to unpack it.

    capsule  sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

Nothing was unpacked or installed. The archive was deleted.

The archive has an absolute path, a .. component or a link that leaves its own
directory. A correctly built capsule never does, so the archive is faulty or
hostile.

Do not unpack it by hand. Report the digest above to idris2x using the runbook
below.

More: idris2x explain E-CAPSULE-INVALID
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-CAPSULE-INVALID.adoc
----

=== E-CAPSULE-INVALID, case `tree-mismatch`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-CAPSULE-INVALID (exit 21)

The capsule unpacked, and its files do not match its own checksum list.

    capsule  sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

Nothing was installed. The unpacked files were deleted.

The archive as a whole matched the lock, so the fault was built into the
capsule, or the disk damaged the files while unpacking.

Try once more, in case the disk was at fault:

    idris2x install --locked

If it fails the same way, report the digest above to idris2x using the runbook
below.

More: idris2x explain E-CAPSULE-INVALID
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-CAPSULE-INVALID.adoc

idris2x: E-CAPSULE-INVALID (exit 21)

    capsule  sha256:0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

== E-CHANNEL-ROLLBACK

=== E-CHANNEL-ROLLBACK, case `version-went-back`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-CHANNEL-ROLLBACK (exit 22)

The channel offered an older manifest than this project has already seen.

    manifest       https://channel.example.org/v1.json
    lock-has-seen  7
    now-offered    5

The lock file was not changed. Everything already pinned still runs.

Manifest versions only go up. An older one usually means a mirror that has not
caught up. It can also be an attempt to hide a newer release.

Wait an hour, then try again:

    idris2x pin 0.8.0

If it is still older tomorrow, report it using the runbook below. There is no
flag that accepts an older manifest.

More: idris2x explain E-CHANNEL-ROLLBACK
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-CHANNEL-ROLLBACK.adoc
----

== E-CHANNEL-EXPIRED

=== E-CHANNEL-EXPIRED, case `expired`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-CHANNEL-EXPIRED (exit 23)

The channel manifest is past its expiry time.

    manifest         https://channel.example.org/v1.json
    expired-at       2026-10-01T00:00:00Z
    this-clock-says  2026-11-16T09:30:00Z

The lock file was not changed. Everything already pinned still runs.

Manifests are re-signed regularly, so a stale one means a mirror is serving an
old copy, the channel is no longer maintained, or this machine's clock is wrong.

Check the clock line above. If it is right, try again later:

    idris2x pin 0.8.0

To pin from the expired manifest anyway, set IDRIS2X_ALLOW_EXPIRED=1. That gives
up protection against being shown an outdated list of releases, so use it only
when you know why the manifest is old.

More: idris2x explain E-CHANNEL-EXPIRED
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-CHANNEL-EXPIRED.adoc
----

== E-STORE-IO

=== E-STORE-IO, case `cannot-create`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-STORE-IO (exit 24)

I could not create a directory the store needs.

    path  /opt/shared/idris2x

Nothing was installed.

The directory's parent is missing, read-only, or owned by another user.

Either fix the permissions, or put the store somewhere you can write:

    export IDRIS2X_CACHE="$HOME/.cache/idris2x"

The store path must not contain spaces if you compile programs with the Chez
backend.

More: idris2x explain E-STORE-IO

=== E-STORE-IO, case `rename-failed`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-STORE-IO (exit 24)

The capsule unpacked correctly, and I could not move it into its place in the
store.

    store-entry  /home/ada/.cache/idris2x/store/sha256-0d7a4c1e9b52f6a83c07d1e45b9a2f6c8e13d7b0a5942c6f1e8d3b7a094c5e21

Nothing was installed. The unpacked files were removed.

The final step is a single rename, so that a capsule is either complete or
absent. The rename fails when the store and its staging area are on different
filesystems, or the store is read-only.

Check that the store directory is on one writable filesystem, then run the same
command again.

More: idris2x explain E-STORE-IO
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-STORE-IO.adoc

=== E-STORE-IO, case `no-cache-dir`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-STORE-IO (exit 24)

IDRIS2X_CACHE, XDG_CACHE_HOME and HOME are all unset, so I cannot tell where the
store should be.

Nothing was downloaded or changed.

idris2x keeps capsules in IDRIS2X_CACHE, else in XDG_CACHE_HOME/idris2x, else in
HOME/.cache/idris2x. It does not fall back to the current directory, which would
put a separate store in each project.

Choose a directory for the store, then run the same command again:

    export IDRIS2X_CACHE=<directory>

The store path must not contain spaces if you compile programs with the Chez
backend.

More: idris2x explain E-STORE-IO
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-STORE-IO.adoc
----

== E-OUTPUT

=== E-OUTPUT, case `write-failed`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-OUTPUT (exit 25)

I could not write my output, so it is incomplete.

    reason  No space left on device (os error 28)

The output is incomplete. Anything the command did before it tried to write is
kept.

The disk or file that the output goes to is full, or the program reading it
stopped before the end, as head does.

Send the output to a file on a disk with free space, or to a program that reads
all of it, then run the same command again.

More: idris2x explain E-OUTPUT
https://github.com/metadatastician/idris2x/blob/main/docs/runbooks/E-OUTPUT.adoc

=== E-INTERNAL, case `missing-tool`

.Style A, plain (not a terminal, NO_COLOR set, or TERM=dumb)
[source,text]
----
idris2x: E-INTERNAL (exit 70)

The bash prototype needs the program flock, and it is not installed.

    missing  flock

Nothing was run.

The prototype is a shell script that calls ordinary system tools. The real
launcher will not need them.

Install flock with your system's package manager, then run the same command
again.
